quest.name: The Banker's Firewood
quest.description: Rook has promised firewood to Elias at the bank.

talk.text: Bring 5 wood to Elias the banker and tell him about the {delivery}. Then come back to me for 125 caps.

stage.journal: Bring 5 wood to Elias and tell him about the delivery.

objective.reply: Firewood from Rook? Thank you. Tell him it arrived.
Elias received his firewood. Here are 125 caps.

ending.journal: Elias received the firewood. Rook paid you 125 caps.

reply.text: Elias is still waiting for 5 wood.
